g.text: The Repopulation Race, Resolved by Version
A stale read loses to a concurrent invalidation; a fresh re-fetch is still allowed through
The check is version < watermark, not <=. A repopulation strictly older than the last-seen
invalidation is discarded (step 4). A fresh re-fetch that matches the current watermark exactly
(step 7) is still allowed through -- it's not stale, it IS the current truth.
No lock anywhere: this is a compare-then-write, atomic per key at the storage layer, not a mutex.
